# testing Provider

This document covers generator mappings to and from the Terraform type
system, OAS properties, and x-speakeasy-* annotations. Terraform Provider
generation and testing requires stateful request and response handling,
which is why this document is separate from the standard language SDK
document.

Each concept (whether Terraform, OAS, or Speakeasy) should be implemented in
an individual Terraform resource while test cases should cover request only,
response only, and both request and response handling since the generator
must merge multiple and/or manipulate parts of the AST to support Terraform
properly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    testing = {
      source  = "hashicorp/testing"
      version = "0.0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "testing" {
  hostname    = "..." # Optional - can use TESTING_HOSTNAME environment variable
  server_port = "..." # Optional - can use TESTING_PORT environment variable
  server_url  = "..." # Optional
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Custom global API Key security scheme description. Configurable via environment variable `TESTING_API_KEY`.
- `audience` (String, Sensitive) Custom global OAuth Client Credentials flow description audience.
- `bearer` (String, Sensitive) Custom global HTTP Bearer token description. Configurable via environment variable `TESTING_BEARER`.
- `client_id` (String, Sensitive) Custom global OAuth Client Credentials flow description client identifier. Configurable via environment variable `TESTING_CLIENT_ID`.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Custom global OAuth Client Credentials flow description client secret. Configurable via environment variable `TESTING_CLIENT_SECRET`.
- `custom_key` (String, Sensitive) Custom security scheme key. Configurable via environment variable `TESTING_CUSTOM_KEY`.
- `custom_secret` (String, Sensitive) Custom security scheme secret. Configurable via environment variable `TESTING_CUSTOM_SECRET`.
- `global_boolean` (Boolean) x-speakeasy-globals defined global boolean
- `global_boolean_with_default` (Boolean) x-speakeasy-globals defined global boolean with default (true)
- `global_enum_float32` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global enum float32 [1.2, 3.4]
- `global_enum_float64` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global enum float64 [1.2, 3.4]
- `global_enum_int32` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global enum int32 [1, 2]; must be one of [1, 2]
- `global_enum_int64` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global enum int64 [3, 4]; must be one of [3, 4]
- `global_enum_integer` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global enum integer [5, 6]; must be one of [5, 6]
- `global_enum_number` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global enum number [1.2, 3.4]
- `global_enum_string` (String) x-speakeasy-globals defined global enum string [value1, value2]; must be one of ["value1", "value2"]
- `global_float32` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global float32
- `global_float32_with_default` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global float32 with default (1.2)
- `global_float64` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global float64
- `global_float64_with_default` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global float64 with default (3.4)
- `global_int32` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global int32
- `global_int32_with_default` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global int32 with default (12)
- `global_int64` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global int64
- `global_int64_with_default` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global int64 with default (34)
- `global_integer` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global integer
- `global_integer_with_default` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global integer with default (56)
- `global_number` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global number
- `global_number_with_default` (Number) x-speakeasy-globals defined global number with default (5.6)
- `global_string` (String) x-speakeasy-globals defined global string
- `global_string_with_default` (String) x-speakeasy-globals defined global string with default (DEFAULT)
- `hostname` (String) The hostname of the server. (defaults to localhost)
- `http_headers` (Map of String) HTTP headers to include in all requests
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Custom global HTTP Basic security scheme description password. Configurable via environment variable `TESTING_PASSWORD`.
- `server_port` (String) The port on which the server is running. (defaults to 35123); must be one of ["8443", "35123"]
- `server_url` (String) Server URL (defaults to http://{hostname}:{port})
- `tls_skip_verify` (Boolean) Disable TLS verification in HTTP client
- `token_url` (String, Sensitive) Custom global OAuth Client Credentials flow description token URL.
- `username` (String, Sensitive) Custom global HTTP Basic security scheme description username. Configurable via environment variable `TESTING_USERNAME`.
